profiles.label: GPT Image natural-language profile
profiles.source_note: Keep instructions as natural language; do not emit Stable Diffusion weights or undocumented control syntax. Verify provider-specific behavior at runtime.

profiles.label: Nano Banana / Gemini Image profile
profiles.source_note: Describe subject, scene, composition, lighting, camera intent, text and edit constraints in natural language; preserve reference roles explicitly.

profiles.label: Seedream profile
profiles.source_note: Use a concise subject-to-scene description and keep identity, product, text and composition locks close to the relevant instruction.

profiles.label: FLUX / Qwen Image profile
profiles.source_note: Prefer concrete visual nouns and relationships over keyword piles; put exclusions in a final constraints sentence when the provider supports it.

profiles.label: Generic image compatibility profile
profiles.source_note: Fallback profile for an unknown provider or model. Never assume unsupported parameters or reference-image syntax.
